PM2 Process Manager: Keep Your Node.js App Alive in Production

Quick thread 🧵

The PM2 process manager keeps your Node.js app running: it restarts the process on crash, runs a copy on every CPU core in cluster mode, reloads new code with zero downtime, and (once you run `pm2 startup` and `pm2 save`) brings everything back after a reboot.
Define it once in an `ecosystem.config.js` file, commit that to your repo, and you stop babysitting the process.
